gloss: right wing (politics); right flank (military); right field (baseball)

definitions.explanation: Conservative or nationalist political ideology, or a person or group holding such views.
The right side of a military formation or sports field. In baseball, refers to right field or right fielder.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A right-wing organization held a demonstration.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右翼|うよく}{寄|よ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げている→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: That political party advocates right-leaning policies.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、{右翼|うよく}ポピュリズム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧し、⟦{移民|いみん}→移民：05314_imin⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めぐる⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧になっている。
examples.english: In recent years, right-wing populism has risen in Europe, and debate over immigration policy has become more active.

examples.japanese: {右翼|うよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飛|と}んだ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A fly ball went to right field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{右翼手|うよくしゅ}→右翼手：29929_uyokushu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is playing an active role as a right fielder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右翼|うよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手薄|てうす}→手薄：30605_teusu⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{攻|せ}める→攻める：02123_semeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The enemy's right flank was thinly defended, so we decided to attack from there.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {右翼|うよく} in a political sense often refers to ultranationalist groups, some of which are known for driving black propaganda trucks (⟦{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}→街宣車：30695_gaisensha⟧) through cities. The term can refer to the political ideology in general or to organized groups specifically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右翼|うよく}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: right-wing organization
- {右翼|うよく}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: right-wing ideology
- {右翼|うよく}{寄|よ}り: right-leaning
- ⟦{右翼手|うよくしゅ}→右翼手：29929_uyokushu⟧: right fielder (baseball)
- ⟦{極右|きょくう}→極右：23932_kyokuu⟧: far right

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{左翼|さよく}→左翼：22746_sayoku⟧ (left wing). ⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧ (conservative) is a more neutral term for right-leaning political views, while {右翼|うよく} can carry a stronger, more ideological connotation.
